title: AlterContacts
description_en: AI client relationship assistant that thinks and does ahead. AlterContacts is a voice-first AI assistant that helps you remember every client and never miss an important follow-up. Just talk about your meeting, and Alter organizes the details, updates the client's profile, and remembers what you promised. It notices upcoming renewals, personal milestones, and relationships that need attention, then prepares your next message for approval. Built for financial advisors, brokers, and consultants who care about relationships, not CRM data entry.

title: AI Context Flow MCP
description_en: Memory you control, synced to every agent, tool and team. Ten AI tools, ten partial memories, all drifting apart, with no record of who changed what. AI Context Flow fixes that with one shared memory over MCP. Save a client brief in Claude, and tomorrow your ChatGPT, Grok Bot and your teammate’s Cursor all work from the same version. Organize memory into buckets by project or client, choose who can access each one, and see every edit in full version history. If an agent overwrites something, roll it back.

title: Yoroll
description_en: Build playable stories without a game engine. Yoroll lets anyone turn stories into playable, cinematic games without coding or a game engine. Start with a script, image, or video clip, then direct the scenes, add player choices, and create branching storylines with different outcomes. AI helps bring everything together into an interactive experience you can share. It's more like directing your own interactive movie than programming a game.

title: Rankhog
description_en: Get customers from Reddit on autopilot. Rankhog finds people on Reddit asking for what you sell. It reads each subreddit's rules, writes a reply that helps, and posts it from your own account at a human pace. Say yes to each reply, or turn on autopilot. No Reddit account? Rankhog warms up a new one, and you own it. Run it from the app, or from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client. 7 days free.

title: Codemany
description_en: Run GitHub Actions 3x faster. Run GitHub Actions on your own infra. Codemany orchestrates the runners: a fresh VM for each job. 3x faster, and NO per-minute bill. Our CI bill went from $215 in October to $4 so far in November. Free 14 days, no card.

title: Glassmail
description_en: A fast Mac email app with AI that never leaves your Mac. Most new email apps charge you every month and send your mail to their servers so their AI can read it. Glassmail doesn't. It's a native Mac app for Gmail, iCloud, Outlook and any IMAP account, and its AI runs on your Mac. Ask "what needs me today?" and get an answer. Type "yes, but next week" and get a reply in your own voice. Clear your inbox one key at a time. There's no mail server and no subscription. You pay once, and it's yours.

title: Resurf
description_en: Personal Knowledge Base & Bookmark Manager for Mac. A fully local personal context library for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Save notes, links, images, and documents. Hand off context to AI through MCP or the CLI on Mac.

title: OpenVorld
description_en: Give your AI agents a home and a Vorld.. OpenVorld is an open-source harness for AI agents, with a visible world on top. Every project is a pixel-art village, and every agent has a name, a role and a brain: Claude Code, Codex or any OpenAI-compatible API. You watch the crew work, and they ask before they use a folder, a command or a website. Free, open source and local. No account needed.

title: oovi
description_en: Your own team of AI on your desktop. Hand oovi a job and a team of AI bots does it: a leader plans, a researcher digs, a writer drafts, a critic checks. Watch each bot work, and approve anything before it goes out. Free with your own AI key, or from $10/mo with credits that never expire.

title: Shipyard
description_en: MCP for Claude, Cursor and Codex to Automate Integrations. Built for the vibecoding era, where anyone can build an app in a night and the slow part is everything around it. Shipyard is a local CLI and MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Connect your accounts once, then every new product gets its domain, DNS, hosting, database, email and payments set up automatically in about an hour. Your AI gets a build prompt for the exact stack. Ship more ideas, faster. Your keys never leave your computer.

title: Omi CLI
description_en: An AI coding agent in your terminal, on 13 models. Omi can build anything, now from your terminal. Omi CLI reads your repo, shows every edit as a diff you approve, and runs tests until they pass. New in 0.5.0: parallel subagents, browser testing, background and cloud agents. Free: npm i -g @builditomi/cli

title: Webless Agents
description_en: Agents you want to put in front of customers. You wouldn’t put most website chatbots in front of a customer. Webless Agents are different: you describe the outcome you want in plain English, and Webless builds the agent on your published content, so it answers only from what you’ve said. You review every instruction and change anything before it goes live. Then it gets to work: answering questions, qualifying buyers, sending quotes, booking meetings and handing off to your team. For Product Hunt: 3 months of our highest plan, free.

title: Ulika
description_en: Visual editor for sites built with Claude, Cursor, or Codex. AI can ship a React, Vite, or Next site in a weekend. Then marketing wants a headline change and opens a ticket. Ulika connects the site so anyone can edit copy and images on the page and publish, without touching code. Open beta, free to try at ulika.co.

title: Prompt Puncher
description_en: The AI CEO Fighting Game. Prompt Puncher is a free browser fighting game where AI CEOs throw hands. Fight as Elon Musk, Sam Altman, Mark Zuckerberg, and more. No downloads or signups required.

title: Wispim
description_en: The teleprompter that follows your voice. Wispim listens and follows the words you actually say. Pause, and it waits. Speed up, and it keeps up. The script floats over Instagram, TikTok or your camera while you record. iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and Windows, and free in your browser.

title: Publicit
description_en: Omnichannel ad infrastructure for marketers and AI agents. Publicit is self-serve infrastructure to buy advertising across connected TV, street screens and mobile from one API. Choose audience and budget, upload your creative, and our real-time bidder buys the spaces on every channel, with delivery measured hour by hour. Each space shows its price before you buy. Sign-up is free. Built on OpenRTB, with a native MCP server to run campaigns from Claude or ChatGPT.

title: Stitch Loop
description_en: Google’s AI agent that ships fixes and watches the metric. Stitch Loop is an experimental product agent from Google Labs. It connects to your GitHub repo and live product data like logs, user behavior and feedback, proposes fixes, builds them in a cloud sandbox and opens a pull request. Nothing merges without human review. Built-in loops cover security, latency and accessibility, plus custom goals like checkout conversion. It keeps monitoring the metric after launch. Waitlist open worldwide, with priority for eligible Google AI Ultra users.

title: AnyProfile
description_en: Free open-source antidetect browser for Mac & Windows. Free open-source antidetect browser for Mac & Windows. Isolate cookies, proxies, Android 15 VMs & AI MCP locally, with zero monthly fees.

title: gitroots
description_en: Path-level GitHub access for developers and AI agents. gitroots is a governance layer for GitHub. Give each developer and AI agent access to only the paths they need, route their changes through approvals, and keep a searchable audit trail. Widen access to your code without handing over the whole repository.

title: TeaserKit
description_en: your coding agent directs your launch video. TeaserKit is the director for your coding agent's videos. Installed in one line, it makes Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents direct a launch video, ad or explainer from your repo or website: a concept, a house style, a human-made song cut to the beat and a quality check before the final render. Includes a local Studio app. One-time purchase.

title: DeNotch
description_en: Hide the MacBook notch and tame your menu bar. DeNotch hides the MacBook notch behind a black bar that works on any wallpaper, dynamic and Aerial ones included, and never edits your files. It tidies your menu bar too: hide icons behind ⌄, put them where you want, and show apps only while they matter, like your VPN while it's connected. Beside the notch, a pill holds live widgets (CPU, battery, network, a timer, now playing, GitHub, AI usage limits) and a cat. Free during the beta, for macOS 26 and later.

title: SuperMailbox
description_en: Your email in one inbox, ready for AI. Bring Gmail, iCloud Mail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts into one inbox. Find emails by meaning across languages with semantic search. Create mail rules and share access with your team. Connect ChatGPT, Claude or another compatible AI assistant through MCP to summarize threads and draft replies, with separate permissions for AI access. Plans start at $4.99/month with a 7-day free trial.

title: WaitFeed
description_en: Tech feed inside agent wait time. Your agent is working. You’re sitting idle or bleeding focus into random tabs. Every wait is dead time that breaks your flow. WaitFeed kills it. It turns every wait into a powerful tech briefing, so you stay informed and locked in without ever leaving your terminal. Fresh dev stories, repos, and live developer discussions stream straight into your terminal. Never in your way. 100% local. Zero API keys. Zero tokens. Free and open source. One command and it’s live.

title: LoudFlow
description_en: We taught text to speech to think. Most voices read the letters. LoudFlow understands the sentence first, so it sounds like a person, not a machine. Watch the video to hear the difference. Then select text in any app, press two keys, and listen. In any voice, even your own. Free on Mac and Windows.

title: Zapyso
description_en: Free meeting notes and dictation that stay on your Mac. Zapyso records your calls on the Mac itself, with no bot joining, and writes a transcript and a summary with decisions and next steps. It notices calls in Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Slack and more. Hold the right ⌘ key to dictate into any app. Speech recognition and summaries run on-device, so recordings and notes never leave your Mac. No account. Free, on Mac and iPhone. Needs Apple silicon and macOS 15.

title: 30yr-uptime
description_en: Claude Code mod for taking care of your body. A Claude Code mod that turns waiting on Claude into movement breaks. Every 45 min, when a turn runs past 15s, a pixel character acts out one of 16 moves for your neck, back, hips, legs, wrists, eyes or lungs. Done, In 5 min or Skip. Local, zero tokens.

title: Squint
description_en: Explains whatever you're looking at, now on Mac. Now on Mac. Press a hotkey, drag a box around anything on your screen, and the answer starts streaming in beside it within moments. No switching apps, no chat window. Also new since the first launch: answers in your own language, one-press copy to hand a capture to your coding agent, and a Microsoft Store install. Windows and Linux too. Free plan, no card.

title: Perfstaq
description_en: Are you a top 1% developer? Prove it in one command. Anyone can claim 5 years of TypeScript. Perfstaq lets you prove it. One command reads your own git history and your Claude Code, Cursor and Codex sessions, on your laptop. Your code never leaves it. Then GitHub spot-checks your commits at random to prove they're really yours. You get your exact standing (Top 1%, 2%, 3%…), cards made to share, and a link any client can verify in 5 seconds. Free, with an open-source scanner.

title: Wiral.Social
description_en: LinkedIn growth, for the rest of us. Grow on LinkedIn without staring at a blank screen. Wiri (your AI-ghostwriter) learns your stories and opinions, then writes posts that sound like you, not AI. Get 3 fresh posts a day, catch mistakes before you post, and plan your whole week in 20 minutes.

title: Fenna Crew
description_en: Grok Bot, but open source and on your Claude Code plan. Grok Bot showed what bots with their own computer can do. Fenna Crew is the open source version that runs on your machine and uses the AI you already pay for: Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity. Give a bot a job and a schedule. It works in its own browser, files and docs, sheets and slides editors, never yours. Watch it, take over to type a password, and it asks before anything risky. No account, free, AGPL.

title: Click
description_en: Build an Online Store From One Photo in 60 Seconds. Click lets you create a fully functional online store in seconds. Upload a product photo and instantly generate product pages, marketing content, and shipping-ready storefronts powered by AI.

title: Colors & Fonts
description_en: Palettes, Shaders , Gradients & Theme Tools. Free color and design tools for designers and developers, now redesigned. New: a Shader Library of animated backgrounds you can open and customize, grid mesh gradients with CSS export, and an MCP server for Cursor, Claude and VS Code. Also: an animated shader builder with embed, PNG and video export, a theme builder that exports CSS, Tailwind, SCSS, Figma and JSON tokens, palettes, CSS gradients, color breakdowns, Google Font pairings and a color picker.
